name: Resultant Systems (RSY)
description: Definition and parameterization of resultant systems RSY(SCR), port maps IP@/OP@, and open-loop vs closed-loop systems.

elements.text: RSY = {(SCR, Z): SCR is a system coupling recipe; Z is the resultant system with feedback wiring via CSCR and external I/O on UISCR/UOSCR.}
SZ = ⅹ (SZ1, ..., SZn), the product of component state spaces.
IZ = ⅹ (A1, ..., Aa) where {A1, ..., Aa} = UISCR.
OZ = ⅹ (B1, ..., Bb) where {B1, ..., Bb} = UOSCR.
NZ applies each component next-state function on inputs resolved from external inputs and feedback connections in CSCR.
RZ projects component readouts onto unconnected output ports UOSCR.
Unconnected input ports are elements of UISCR.
Unconnected output ports are elements of UOSCR.
For a connected input port, the feeding output port is determined by CSCR.
Component input functions combine external inputs on UISCR with feedback values from connected outputs.
IP@(SCR, Z) maps resultant input ports to unconnected component input ports.
INIP@(SCR, Z) is the inverse of IP@(SCR, Z).
IS@(SCR, Z) gives input port value types on resultant input ports.
OP@(SCR, Z) maps resultant output ports to unconnected component output ports.
INOP@(SCR, Z) is the inverse of OP@(SCR, Z).
OS@(SCR, Z) gives output port value types on resultant output ports.
Open-loop system Z& = CSY(VSCR).
Closed-loop system Z@ = RSY(SCR).
Parameter bundle (SCR, total component readouts) for the RSY parameterization.
Relational membership (SCR, Z) ∈ RSY when Z is the resultant of SCR.
